8.  “An inability to feel the Spirit, or a general feeling of apathy or numbness, [can also be] a symptom of poor mental health” (“ At times I have difficulty feeling the Spirit because I feel numb … ,” in “Mental Health: Help for Me,” Life Help, Gospel Library). If you experience difficulties with your mental or emotional health, please be assured of Heavenly Father’s love for you, and continue to pray to Him and trust in Him.
